'''Menerus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], when he was stationed aboard the ''[[Dorin's Sky]]'', a [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. When the ''Dorin's Sky'' was boarded by the Sith, Menerus was [[Death/Legends|killed]] defending the ship.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Menerus appears as one of the bosses in the Boarding Party Flashpoint appearing in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
